description.value: Pelican Seafood Restaurant (又一村海鲜酒家) is a family-owned Chinese seafood restaurant that has been operating in East Vancouver for over 10 years. The menu spans dim sum, lunch, and full dinners, with custom-order meals accommodating a range of dietary preferences. A street-facing patio adds an outdoor dining option for cyclists passing through the area.

address.value: 1895 E Hastings St, Vancouver, BC V5L 1T3
